title: Awesome openclaw skills: awesome-list for AI assistant skills, 700+ community tools
description:
Remember when OpenClaw was called Moltbot? And before that Clawdbot? This repo has kept up through all the rebrands. It's basically the awesome-list for AI assistant skills—700+ community tools organized into 27 categories. Browser automation, DevOps, health tracking, podcast management, everything. Every skill works with Claude Code and other assistants that respect the standard.

https://github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-openclaw-skills
